about: The Mac of #490, as far as the issue shows it: a game whose env.txt from 1.0.0 syncs through iCloud Drive/nxnative_launcher and keeps its save there (DM_SAVE), saved choices that env.txt hides, and the iPhone syncing the same game through another folder with a newer save. The iPhone's folder name is a stand-in, the issue does not name it. Run: python3 tools/verify local --fixture home-490

files.Library/Application Support/nxnative/010:
DM_FPS_TARGET=60
DM_METAL_HUD=1
DM_OPMODE=1
DM_RENDER_SCALE=1.00
DM_PRESENT_UPSCALE=metalfx
DM_FULLSCREEN=1
DM_SAVE=$HOME/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/nxnative_launcher/The Legend of Zelda Links Awakening/save
DM_SAVE_SYNC=$HOME/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/nxnative_launcher

folders: Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/nxnative_launcher/The Legend of Zelda Links Awakening/save
